title: RL Companion dev bridge v1
description: GENERATED from packages/contract/src/companion-dev-bridge.schema.ts and companion-dev-bridge-endpoints.schema.ts — do not edit by hand. One $defs entry per /dev/v1/* body plus the probe request/result. Refinements enforced by the Zod schema but not expressible here: probe fn paths must pass allowlist.json (deny wins); exactly one of fn/presence per call; "$i" only with forEach; call ids unique; forEach.countFrom names an earlier fn call; ≤40 keys per result table; relative paths have no "..", drive or backslash; log lines hold no unredacted token (any letter case). Byte caps, measured as UTF-8 of the JSON serialisation: every response body ≤16 KiB, a probe request ≤4 KiB measured as its largest queue entry (output form + probeId, flavor padded to 34 chars), each probe-result item (a call without iterations, or one iteration) ≤3 KiB, a whole probe result ≤64 KiB; see CONTRACT.md.
